scenes.text: A famous Hollywood movie star co-invented a secret radio system in World War Two.
Her name was Hedy Lamarr, born in Austria on November ninth, nineteen fourteen.
With composer George Antheil, she patented a way for radio signals to hop between frequencies.
The idea was to stop enemies from jamming radio-controlled torpedoes.
Frequency hopping is now seen as an important step in wireless communication.
She was inducted into the National Inventors Hall of Fame in twenty fourteen.
Did you know this movie star was an inventor?

title: This movie star secretly invented a radio system 🎬
caption: Actress Hedy Lamarr (born Nov 9, 1914) and composer George Antheil patented a frequency-hopping system in 1942 to protect radio-guided torpedoes from jamming. 📶
